description: Market approach: value from comparable transaction revenue multiples, capitalize a royalty stream into a perpetuity value, score brand strength, and value a brand by Interbrand. Method selects the formula. Use when reliable comparable transactions or royalty rates exist for the subject asset. For income-based excess earnings use valuation_income_methods; for royalty-rate selection and adjustment use valuation_royalty_analysis. Per method: comparable_transactions needs comparables + subject_revenue (optional: adjustments); royalty_capitalization needs revenue + royalty_rate + discount_rate; brand_strength_index needs revenue_stability + market_share + geographic_reach + customer_loyalty + investment_level; interbrand_brand needs brand_earnings + role_of_brand_index + brand_strength_score + discount_rate. Each comparable is {sale_price, revenue, asset_type}; comparable_transactions divides sale_price by revenue and applies the median implied multiple to subject_revenue. Only method is required; all other parameters are method-dependent — supply those the selected method names and omit the rest (defaults apply where defined). Rates and premiums are decimals (0.10 = 10%). Pure arithmetic: no I/O and no external calls; values carry the library's own precision (rates are decimals, so a royalty rate of 0.055 is not rounded); parameters belonging to other methods are accepted and ignored. An unknown method, or a missing method-required parameter, returns an error instead of a value.

adjustments.description: Map from comparable index (0-based) to an adjustment applied as (1 + adjustment): {0: 0.10} raises the first comparable's multiple by 10%.

brand_earnings.description: Profit attributable to the brand, in currency units.

brand_strength_score.description: Composite brand strength score on a 0-100 scale.

discount_rate.description: Per-period discount rate as a decimal (0.10 = 10%).

investment_level.description: Brand investment level score from 0 to 1.

method.description: Formula to apply. Options: comparable_transactions = Subject revenue times the median comparable multiple.; royalty_capitalization = Value = (revenue * royalty rate) / discount rate.; brand_strength_index = Composite brand strength score on a 0-100 scale.; interbrand_brand = Brand valued by the Interbrand methodology.

revenue.description: Annual revenue attributable to the asset, in currency units.

role_of_brand_index.description: Share of brand earnings attributable to the brand, as a decimal (0.50 = 50%).

royalty_rate.description: Royalty rate as a decimal (0.05 = 5% of revenue).

subject_revenue.description: Subject company revenue, in currency units.

assumptions.description: Modelling assumptions applied (list of strings or key/value object).

defaults_applied.description: Optional parameters that were not supplied, so their documented defaults were used.

error.description: Error message when the call fails.

method.description: Formula / method name that produced the result.

steps.description: Intermediate calculation steps for traceability (one string per step).
